verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents a Scheduled Messages API endpoint, which implies emails can be scheduled for later delivery and tracked via the API. However, the evidence only says it is used to 'keep track of' scheduled messages. Nothing explicitly shows a scheduling parameter on the send endpoint or a call to cancel or delete a scheduled message. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a send-time/schedule parameter in the Email API, documented cancellation of a scheduled email before delivery, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule an email for future delivery through the API and cancel it before it goes out

citations.quote: Keep track of scheduled messages using MailerSend's Scheduled Messages API endpoint.
This endpoint allows you to send an asynchronous email.
